summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its October 1, 2026 disclosure letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange and Philippine SEC confirming completion of its acquisition of the remaining 65.1% equity interest in Radius Telecoms, Inc., taking PLDT to 100% ownership of Radius's issued and outstanding capital stock. The filing follows a prior letter dated May 14, 2026, indicating a staged deal; no price per share, total consideration, premium or advisor was disclosed, and no board recommendation or regulatory clock remains. Watch for purchase-price and funding disclosures, integration of Radius's fixed-broadband assets, and any minority-appraisal or competition follow-ups.
